item.title: JavaScript Event Listeners in Action
item.description: Alright, following up on our previous note about DOM and BOM… So we already know how to select an element and swap its text. Cool. But a webpage where nothing reacts when you click or scroll? Kinda lifeless, isn’t it? :v To actually make elements respond when users interact with the page, we need Event Listeners. Wait, what is an event anyway? An “event” is basically anything that happens inside the browser.
